text: Months later, the council met in broad daylight, furious, ready to condemn Jesus without a hearing.
And one voice rose to stop them.
Does our law judge a man, he asked, before it hears him?
He was defending Jesus to the most powerful men in the nation — the very room he had everything to lose in.
They turned on him for it.
The man who once came at night was starting to speak in the light.
